note: Editable approved-capability catalog. Approval and data rules are applied first, then capabilities and task fit. Workspace files can never change this file; only the Settings page or an administrator can. Values here are defaults; var/settings.json overrides approval per user.

data_classes.internal: Internal source code and documents, no customer or personal data
data_classes.restricted: Contains customer, personal or secret data

tools.label: GitHub Copilot (VS Code)
tools.handoff: Paste the work package into Copilot Chat (Agent mode) or save it as a .prompt.md file. No MCP required.
limits: Works on files open in your workspace
tools.notes: Approved for code and office work (documents, emails, summaries) in VS Code.

tools.label: Claude Code (VS Code)
tools.handoff: Paste the work package into Claude Code; start in plan mode. No MCP required.
limits: No MCP servers or extra skills unless you install the agent kit
tools.notes: Approved for code and office work in VS Code.

tools.label: Devin (web)
tools.handoff: Paste the work package into a new Devin session and attach the matching playbook. Requires the repository to be connected in Devin already.
limits: Repository must already be connected in Devin
tools.notes: Best for long, well-specified, repo-wide work you review as a PR.

tools.label: Microsoft 365 Copilot (if enabled)
tools.handoff: Paste the text into your approved writing assistant.
limits: Enable only if your organization provides it
tools.notes: Optional. Copilot and Claude Code are also approved for office work.

tools.label: No AI needed: formatter, linter or test runner
tools.handoff: Run the project's own formatter, linter or test command.
tools.notes: Deterministic work is faster, free and exact without AI.
